findings.message: This fix narrows the test instead of fixing it. It no longer passes wrongly on a drifted window. But it now only works while the grid's first month (windowMonths(today, 5), modules/allocations/server/months.ts:6) falls between 2026-09 and 2027-01. The hard-coded 'December (2026-12)' replace text is still fixed to the fixtures' January 2027. That is the same root cause the round-1 finding named, and the test now has an expiry date. From 2027-02-01 it fails on every branch even when the product is correct. The mock lede (apps/mock/public/mock/index.html:1019) describes the narrowed range but doesn't say the test will start failing. Class fix: fix the page's clock to a date inside the fixtures' window (Playwright page.clock.install / setFixedTime, or a server-side 'today' override), so the window, the January column and the 2026-12 → 2027-01 copy can't drift apart. Or build the replace text from the month just before the January column, with its year, and check that the fixtures have data there.
findings.scenario: CI runs on 2027-02-01 → the grid shows Feb–Jun 2027 with no 'Jan' header → janColumn is -1 and expect(janColumn).toBeGreaterThan(1) fails. On 2027-09-01 the grid shows Sep 2027 to Jan 2028 → janColumn is found, but the prompt '…September (2027-09)…' doesn't match the 2026-09..2027-01 regex → the test fails. Either way it is red with no product change.
